user.title: Maison NSPanel
user.description: Choose the weather entity used for the 7-day forecast. A "Take out the bins" reminder (Monday) is created by default and can be edited afterwards.

init.title: Settings
init.description: All Maison NSPanel settings (lighting, reminders, weather, climate, vacuum, appearance) are in the “Maison NSPanel” panel of the Home Assistant sidebar.

options.verre: Dark glass (default): tinted cards, uppercase titles
options.ardoise: Slate: flat, very dark borderless cards, small kickers, sentence-case titles, weather photo kept
